items.exampleEn: The hospital has long, quiet corridors painted white.
items.exampleZh: 那間醫院有又長又安靜、漆成白色的走廊。

items.exampleEn: The workers lifted a long steel beam onto the new building.
items.exampleZh: 工人們把一根長長的鋼梁吊上新大樓。

items.exampleEn: Don't stand in the doorway; people need to get past.
items.exampleZh: 別站在門口，大家要過去。

items.exampleEn: Our neighbor turned her garden shed into a small art studio.
items.exampleZh: 我們的鄰居把她花園裡的小屋改成了一間小畫室。

items.exampleEn: Our neighbors grow tomatoes and beans in their backyard.
items.exampleZh: 我們鄰居在後院種番茄和豆子。

items.exampleEn: I can't get the lid off this jar of honey.
items.exampleZh: 我打不開這罐蜂蜜的蓋子。

items.exampleEn: This village is famous for its white cottages with flower gardens.
items.exampleZh: 這個村莊以附有花園的白色小屋聞名。

items.exampleEn: Good lighting is important for taking clear photos.
items.exampleZh: 要拍出清楚的照片，良好的照明很重要。

items.exampleEn: In the play, the actor uses a cane to look older.
items.exampleZh: 劇中那位演員拄著手杖，讓自己看起來比較老。

items.sentenceEn: The meeting room is at the end of the corridor on the left.
items.sentenceZh: 會議室在走廊盡頭的左邊。

items.audioEn: The garden tools are in the shed behind the garage. The key is under a big stone.
items.audioZh: 園藝工具在車庫後面的小屋裡，鑰匙在一塊大石頭底下。

items.sentenceEn: After hurting his knee, Tom walked with a cane for a month.
items.sentenceZh: 湯姆傷了膝蓋後，拄著手杖走了一個月。

items.sentenceEn: Put the lid on the pot so the soup stays hot.
items.sentenceZh: 把鍋蓋蓋上，湯才會保持熱的。

items.stemEn: The café uses soft, warm ____ to make customers feel relaxed.
items.stemZh: 這家咖啡店用柔和溫暖的燈光，讓客人感到放鬆。

items.stemEn: The old house has heavy wooden ____ across the ceiling.
items.stemZh: 那棟老房子的天花板上橫著粗重的木梁。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family rented a small stone cottage in the countryside. Inside, thick wooden beams ran across the ceiling, and a narrow corridor led to two bedrooms. The lighting was poor at night, so we used candles. Behind the house was a large backyard with an old shed full of garden tools. On the first morning, my little brother stood in the doorway and shouted that a fox was eating from the trash bin, because someone had left the lid off. In the shed, we also found a walking cane carved with tiny birds, a lovely ornament that we put on the shelf.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家在鄉下租了一間石造小屋。屋內，厚實的木梁橫跨天花板，一條窄窄的走廊通往兩間臥室。晚上照明不足，所以我們點蠟燭。房子後面有一個大後院，還有一間放滿園藝工具的舊棚子。第一天早上，弟弟站在門口大叫，說有一隻狐狸在翻垃圾桶，因為有人沒蓋蓋子。我們還在棚子裡找到一根刻著小鳥的手杖，是個可愛的擺飾，我們把它放在架子上。

questions.questionZh: 晚上他們為什麼點蠟燭？
狐狸為什麼會去翻垃圾桶？
options: 因為垃圾桶的蓋子沒蓋上
因為弟弟每天早上都去餵牠
因為後院四周沒有任何圍牆

items.promptZh: 我們把舊腳踏車放在後院的小屋裡。
referenceEn: We keep our old bikes in the shed in the backyard.
We put the old bicycles in the shed in our backyard.
rubricZh: shed 指存放東西的小屋，backyard 指後院（例如 the shed in the backyard）
沒有時間標記，現在式或過去式都可以；「放」可寫 keep、put、store 等

items.instructionZh: 用 cottage 造一個句子，說說你想住或去過的鄉間小屋。
referenceEn: I would love to spend a quiet week in a cottage in the mountains.
Last winter, I stayed in a small cottage near a lake.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 cottage（例如 a cottage by the sea、stay in a cottage）
